title: Mall World as Imaginal Gathering Place
content: Hi everyone, I had one of these mall dreams the other night and discovered that this is a collective event. Those of us who work a lot with dreams are familiar with shared dreams, but this one seems to be unusually widespread. The mall is an interesting symbol. It could mean different things to different people. It could also refer to a dying form of commercialistic gathering that largely replaced the town square or plaza, especially back in the 70's and 80's. Perhaps the dream points to a need for renewed community and gathering.
